newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms pass on 52,500T of corn tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms pass on 52,500T of corn tenders.

text.p: A South Korean buyers group, known as the Top Margin Committee, passed on tenders to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn due to higher-than-expected prices, traders said on Thursday.
Traders said the lowest bid was made by Tradi Grain at $124.98 a tonne C&F if sourced from the Pacific Northwest or at $124.18 a tonne C&F if from the U.S. Gulf.
Arrival of the passed tenders had been set for December 10 to the western port of Inchon.
Shipment had been slated for November 11-30 if from the Pacific Northwest or for October 20-November 10 if from the U.S. Gulf.
